headline: There are delays in permits for new power plants
summary: Analysts report delays in permits for new electric power plants. Under the mixed scheme with state utility CFE, some projects require transmission grid reinforcement that can cost more than the plant itself.
why: The Federal Electricity Commission (CFE) is Mexico's state utility, and private power investment in Mexico depends on permits and grid capacity.
original_headline: Hay retraso en permisos para nuevas plantas eléctricas
